metadata.description: Mods for a founder's development hub, read live from this checkout. See .claude/mods/README.md.

plugins.name: hub-desk
plugins.description: A pane that shows what the hub holds for this repo: the open inbox notes and the owner's queue, re-read after every turn.

plugins.name: hub-gate
plugins.description: Holds a git commit or push until tools/specs_check.py passes; refuses writes to the hub's protected paths under a contributor's git identity.

plugins.name: phase-progress
plugins.description: A pane and a status line with how far the current phase is from done — its verification.md boxes ticked on origin — re-counted each time something merges.
